## Core Expertise
1. **UI/UX & Interactive Product Design** — End-to-end interface architecture, user flows, wireframing, responsive design systems, and interactive web experiences.
2. **Campaign Microsites (Global Retail & Consumer Electronics)** — High-impact promotional microsites built for seasonal retail campaigns, balancing brand storytelling, product discovery, and conversion.
3. **Motion Design & Visual Systems** — Motion graphics, micro-interactions, 3D/key visual art direction, editorial posters, and multi-channel retail visual systems.
